objective: Add reproducible 100/1000 CPVS membership samples and source-backed full-versus-batch equivalence evidence without modifying scientific selection policy.
previous_knowledge_consumed: Issue #170 remains UNRESOLVED: 741786 candidate IDs, 730184 published IDs, 11602 candidate-only IDs, and zero published-only IDs.
Issue #180 requires deterministic samples from the complete 781602-SourceID parent catalog, explicit coverage of published and non-published objects, hashes, and object-level comparison.
Published CPVS membership is a comparison reference, not independent astrophysical ground truth.

baseline.status: CPVS exact-membership reconstruction remains fail-closed and UNRESOLVED; v0.2.0 and v1.0.1 are immutable.

expected_improvement: Generate deterministic 100- and 1000-object sample manifests stratified by published-reference membership.
Record input and manifest SHA-256 values, random seeds, exact SourceIDs, and inclusion counts.
Report candidate-only and published-only SourceIDs without changing thresholds or hardcoding membership.
Provide an optional complete-SourceID keyed comparator for full and batch decision tables.

evidence: PR #182 adds deterministic sample tooling, unit tests, and a source-backed Scientific Validation workflow step to emit compact sample manifests and reference-relative mismatch reports.

root_causes: The residual 11602 candidate-only CPVS objects remain unexplained.

findings: Sampling manifests must include exact object IDs, deterministic seed, stratification counts, and input hashes.
Membership decisions must be keyed by complete CPVS SourceID, not light-curve row position.
Reference-relative FP/FN terminology must not be presented as independent astrophysical truth.

open_blockers: Source-backed CI must generate and review the 100/1000 sample artifacts.
Implement and run the actual full-versus-batch object-level comparison.
Investigate the 11602-object mismatch without tuning thresholds solely to force cardinality equality.

knowledge_carried_forward: Do not merge before required CI passes.
Do not close Issue #180 until sample artifacts and full-versus-batch results are reviewed.
Keep the exact-membership scientific gate UNRESOLVED until evidence supports a different result.
Do not change released v0.2.0 or v1.0.1.
